name: SES Identity Destruction
description: SES identities are the domains and addresses you are allowed to send mail from. After using SES to phish, an attacker may delete the identity so the paper trail is messier and you cannot quickly see what was sent. Mail that was already sent still exists in recipient inboxes. What you lose is control and some of the sending history. Identity deletion right after a spike in SendEmail is a cleanup step, not a routine change.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
